name: Exp_BuySell
summary: This EA trades based on the custom BuySell indicator, which uses an MA and ATR combination to identify trend direction. It opens buy positions when an uptrend signal appears and sell positions when a downtrend signal appears, with configurable stop loss and take profit. The EA includes separate permissions for entering and exiting long and short positions, allowing flexible trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义BuySell指标进行交易，该指标通过MA和ATR组合识别趋势方向。当出现上升趋势信号时开仓做多，出现下降趋势信号时开仓做空，并设有可配置的止损和止盈。EA分别设置了做多、做空入场和出场的权限开关，实现了灵活的交易管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于自定义BuySell指标判断趋势方向，该指标内部使用移动平均线（MA）和平均真实波幅（ATR）来确定趋势状态。入场条件为：当UpTrend缓冲区在当前信号柱有值且前一根柱为DnTrend状态时，产生做多信号；当DnTrend缓冲区在当前信号柱有值且前一根柱为UpTrend状态时，产生做空信号，这是一种趋势反转确认的入场逻辑。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号出现时平仓（如出现卖出信号时平掉多头仓位）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理方面，EA依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的函数来执行交易操作，但代码本身未展示详细的风险控制机制如最大持仓限制或回撤保护。EA使用新柱检测机制避免同根K线内重复交易，并设有信号重算逻辑以应对数据复制失败的情况。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the custom BuySell indicator which internally uses a Moving Average (MA) and Average True Range (ATR) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the UpTrend buffer has a value on the current signal bar and the previous bar was in a DnTrend state; a sell signal is generated when the DnTrend buffer has a value on the current signal bar and the previous bar was in an UpTrend state, representing a trend reversal confirmation logic. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as closing positions on opposite signals (e.g., closing long positions when a sell signal appears). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based sizing. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh include file for trade execution, but the code itself does not demonstrate detailed risk controls such as maximum position limits or drawdown protection. The EA uses a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same bar and includes a signal recalculation logic to handle data copy failures gracefully.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易资金比例，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Trade capital ratio; negative value = fixed lot size

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用新柱检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
买入和卖出的入场与出场权限分开控制，灵活度高，可单独禁用某方向交易
信号生成采用状态切换确认逻辑（前一柱为相反状态），减少假信号入场
具备数据复制失败的容错处理，当CopyBuffer失败时触发重算
止损止盈均可配置，且止盈为止损的2倍，具有正期望的盈亏比设计
pros_en: New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Separate permission switches for buy/sell entry and exit provide high flexibility and allow disabling specific directions
Signal generation uses state transition confirmation (previous bar in opposite state), reducing false signal entries
Fault-tolerant handling for data copy failures with recalculation trigger when CopyBuffer fails
Configurable stop loss and take profit with a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, supporting positive expectancy design
cons: 依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh文件，核心交易逻辑不透明，难以独立审计风险
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能频繁触发止损
未设置最大持仓数量限制或回撤保护机制，极端行情下可能持续加仓
BuySell指标为自定义指标，未内嵌于EA中，部署时需额外安装
固定止损止盈不随市场波动率调整，在不同波动环境下可能不适配
cons_en: Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh file, making core trading logic opaque and difficult to independently audit for risk
No spread filter, which may cause frequent stop loss triggers in high-spread environments
No maximum position count limit or drawdown protection, potentially leading to continuous position addition in extreme markets
The BuySell indicator is a custom indicator not embedded in the EA, requiring separate installation for deployment
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not adapt to market volatility, potentially being mismatched across different volatility regimes
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，使止损距离随市场波动率自适应调整
添加最大同时持仓数量限制和账户回撤保护机制，增强资金安全
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免不利交易环境下开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt stop distances to market volatility
Add maximum simultaneous position limit and account drawdown protection mechanism for capital safety
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions in unfavorable trading conditions

risk_points: 依赖外部包含文件，交易逻辑不透明存在隐患
缺少最大持仓限制和回撤保护，极端行情下风险敞口不可控
固定止损未考虑点差和滑点影响，实际止损可能大于预期
risk_points_en: Dependency on external include file creates hidden risks from opaque trading logic
No maximum position limit or drawdown protection leaves risk exposure uncontrolled in extreme markets
Fixed stop loss does not account for spread and slippage, making actual stop loss potentially larger than expected
